If it is truly absent from the entire Q2 filing, request an explanation from IR as to why this quantitative disclosure was dropped, and monitor whether warranty accruals are growing relative to settlements.

overall.summary: MAS's disclosure quality is generally strong, with detailed quantitative breakdowns of operating results, segment performance, debt terms, and risk factors. The only genuine concern is the removal of the warranty liability rollforward table from the Q2 2025 filing, which eliminated specific dollar-amount tracking of warranty accruals, settlements, and balances. The majority of peer comparison flags actually demonstrate MAS as the superior discloser relative to its comparators.
